prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / production 2D RTS sprite atlas.
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: four original complete Dune II buildings in a 2 by2 row-major grid. Image2 is ONLY STYLE GUIDANCE from the approved construction yard/windtrap redraw. Redraw all four native buildings as crisp coherent whole high-resolution sprites. Preserve Image1 building identities, high-overhead orthographic camera, facing, exact module arrangement, aspect ratios, footprint proportions and order. Do not replace them with the two example buildings in Image2.
Style must match Image2: clean purposeful steel/masonry contours, readable large/medium forms, restrained painted hard-surface cel shading, upper-left daylight, cool steel and muted cobalt-blue faction markings with original warm desert metal accents. Semantic whole object drawings, NOT enlarged source pixels, generic material overlays, 3D glamour isometric redesign, pixel blur, photo noise, cluttered tiny greebles or thick toy outlines. Preserve the reference square or3x2 footprint rather than making every building the same aspect.
Output a transparent square 2x2 sprite atlas, four equal cells, one isolated complete building centered in each cell with large transparent gutters. Approximately1536x1536. Keep attached building plinths but no outside terrain, long shadows, labels, letters, text, frames, grid or backdrop. New lines and shading must remain readable at128px/192px game size. Exact silhouette/layout is authoritative; draw fine continuous contours rather than a pixel mosaic.
Cell1 top-left Spice Refinery: three large dark-steel circular tank lids and pipe machinery on left, long pale loading/unloading platform with blue diamond pads on right. Cell2 top-right Vehicle Repair Centre: low gray hangar with large rounded corrugated roof on right and open repair platform/arm extending left; dark entrance, small hazard marks. Cell3 bottom-left Spice Storage Silo: two large cool-steel cylindrical storage tanks, one upper-left and one lower-right, blue house panels and dark vertical tank walls, narrow square plinth. Cell4 bottom-right Radar Outpost: low broad pale rectangular communications roof on square base, small radar aperture/dish in upper-right roof area and cobalt-blue flag lower-left. Preserve exact native footprint and facing.
